verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST Jobs API, a published OpenAPI spec, a hosted MCP server, an x402 agent API, a ClawHub skill, and Zapier/Google integrations. None of these is an official client SDK library, such as a Python or Node package. The OpenAPI spec is only a building block from which a developer could generate a client, and the MCP and skill surfaces belong to other stories, so no credit transfers here.
